design.help: The default design is built into the application. Files in the INVOICE__DESIGN_DIR directory override it file by file (the same relative path wins): the invoice.typ template, fonts in fonts/, the logo logo.svg or logo.png, a stamp or signature signature.png. Changes apply on the next render without a restart; already archived PDFs stay unchanged.
